answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 32440 Country: GY Title: tabligh, fard or not? Question: A certain scholar has been saying that tabligh is not an obligation on this ummah rather it is an opportunity Allah has given us to obtain reward. is tabligh an obligation? if so what is the source from which we conclude it's obligation? Answer ID: 32440 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 935/781/B=1432) Tabligh has always been fardh on the Ulama of Ummah. There are proofs in the holy Quran and Hadith. It is not right to say that Almighty Allah has only provided this chance to earn reward. وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى الْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنكَرِ [آل عمران : 104] ولتأمرن بالمعروف ولتنهون عن المنكر الخ – (الحديث) بلغوا عنى ولو آية . (الحديث) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
